title: Optim-Account: Cardano L2. Virtual ledger layer for account-model-based txs

ms.promise: Documentation of the design specification of Optim Account (now “Leviathan”) Layer 2 system. This entails all core mechanisms and requirements that bridge beyond Optim's current transaction chaining and off chain systems architecture to what can be considered a more complete and scalable Leviathan implementation. Accompanying public facing documentation to start educating non-technical users of the capabilities of this product.
ms.criteria:
・Document with system design specification requirements

・Account abstraction functionality
・Guaranteed transactions
・Instant finality
・Unbreakable transaction chaining
・Layer 2 execution environment
・Future sequencer network

・Educational content for non-technical users outlining the system architecture, core mechanics, use cases, and practical deployment. 

・Limitations of current transactions chaining paradigm
・Limitations of current inter dApp composability issues
・Explanation of basic design and non-custodial asset inputs 
・Intent based transactions
・Account Base vs eUTxO model app archit
ms.report:
・Proof of Achievement Link to GitHub repository hosting system design specification with all details listed in requirements. 

** Added Gitbook as well**

This will complete the bridge beyond Optim’s current systems architecture to a fuller Layer 2 (aka, Leviathan). This includes on and off chain proof of a working sequencer, intents, and basic account-based actions such as gas and autonomous transactions.

ms.promise: Live public testnet environment and accompanying documentation explaining how to utilize the Leviathan application to a non-technical user base. Leviathan L2 account-based smart contract model extends capabilities for more complex intent-based dApp interactions showcasing composability and settlement with increased transaction speeds from sequencer throughput. This will include a testnet deployment of an automated airdrop dApp using gas and automatic tx execution.

ms.promise:
Initial Leviathan implementation deployed on Cardano mainnet. Showcase the first dApp using the basics of the architecture during a functioning mainnet Beta. A usable dApp will be implemented whereby a user can feed transaction fee gas into an Optim Account then have it execute automatic, intermittent airdrop claims autonomously based on eligible Liquidity Bonds confirmed in wallet.
Followed shortly by, 
Full Leviathan application deployed on Cardano mainnet. A feature complete Leviathan Layer 2 with multiple working dApps (at least 2) and scalable architecture ready for other builders to begin building applications on top of.
ms.criteria:
